outcome: A CSV export is readable by a spreadsheet even when a field contains a delimiter.

acceptance_criteria.text: An ordinary row is written under a header.

expected_verification.assertion: a single row exports as header plus row

acceptance_criteria.text: A field containing a comma, a quote or a line break is escaped so the row is not split.

expected_verification.assertion: a field containing a comma round-trips through a CSV parser as one field
